তারিখ : ২৭ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪১৭ বঙ্গাব্দ/১০ জুন, ২০১০ খ্রিস্টাব্দ।

National Board of Revenue: This is the government authority responsible for the issuance of customs and tax-related notifications under the internal resources division.
Customs Duty: The document pertains to regulatory matters concerning the administration of customs duties and related fiscal instruments.
Value Added Tax: The document pertains to regulatory matters concerning the administration of value added tax and related fiscal instruments.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19 of the Act empowers the Government to issue notifications and amend existing ones regarding customs duties and taxes in the public interest after consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the Government to implement fiscal amendments in conjunction with the Customs Act.
National Board of Revenue: The Government consults with this body before exercising its powers to issue or amend regulatory notifications under customs and tax laws.
S.R.O. 169-AIN/2005: This existing customs notification is subject to further amendments regarding specific entries within its attached table.
Bangladesh Customs Tariff: The notification updates the specific tariff headings used in the import classification table to reflect changes in the coding structure.
